scenarios.name: every member can see the household's subscriptions, but only adults add, change or remove them

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_subscriptions__subscriptions (id, name, category, amount_cents, billing_period, next_renewal_date, payer_id, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'streaming', 1599, 'monthly', '2026-02-01', ?, 'active', ?, ?, ?)

INSERT INTO app_subscriptions__subscriptions (id, name, category, amount_cents, billing_period, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'software', 999, 'monthly', 'active', ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE app_subscriptions__subscriptions SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE id = ?
SELECT id, name, amount_cents, status FROM app_subscriptions__subscriptions

scenarios.name: a subscription amount can never be negative

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_subscriptions__subscriptions (id, name, amount_cents, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO app_subscriptions__subscriptions (id, name, amount_cents, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE app_subscriptions__subscriptions SET amount_cents = -1 WHERE id = ?

scenarios.name: active_subscriptions lists active subscriptions by next renewal and leaves cancelled ones out

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_subscriptions__subscriptions (id, name, category, amount_cents, billing_period, next_renewal_date, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('s_late', 'Spotify', 'streaming', 1199, 'monthly', '2026-03-15', 'active', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'), ('s_soon', 'Home insurance', 'insurance', 90000, 'yearly', '2026-02-01', 'active', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'), ('s_gone', 'Gym', 'memberships', 4000, 'monthly', '2026-02-10', 'cancelled', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
SELECT id FROM app_subscriptions__subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY next_renewal_date LIMIT 1
